clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind’s Dwarven District, Wilder Thistlenettle drinks alone with old grief. He once entered Moonbrook’s Deadmines with his brother and their mining crew, but a cave-in left him the sole survivor.

Wilder Thistlenettle drinks away his sorrow in an alehouse near the Dwarven District’s southeastern gates. Years ago, he joined his brother and their companions in the deep lodes of Moonbrook’s Deadmines. A cave-in sealed the rest of the crew underground, and Wilder barely reached the surface alive.
